rule.statement: A right of way cannot be established on the basis of prescriptive user without evidence of a definite area used as a right of way and more than 10 years of adverse use.
rule.supporting_quote: No right of way can be considered on the basis of prescriptive user as there is no evidence to indicate the definite area used as a right of way as well as more than 10 years of adverse use over the southern portion of Lot A1 after the execution of Deed No.424.
